alter.name: Alter
alter.description: Reshapes physical surroundings: terrain, matter, and the conditions of a place.

battle_meditation.name: Battle Meditation
battle_meditation.description: Coordinates allies so a group acts with more effect.

bind.name: Bind
bind.description: Holds a target in place and keeps it from acting.

conjure.name: Conjure
conjure.description: Calls a temporary object or figure into being.

ebb_flow.name: Ebb/Flow
ebb_flow.description: Draws strength inward or pulls it out of a target.

endure.name: Endure
endure.description: Shrugs off a Critical Injury as it lands.

enhance.name: Enhance
enhance.description: Augments the user's own physical capability on athletic and coordination checks.

farsight.name: Farsight
farsight.description: Extends sight past its normal limits: darkness, distance, obstruction.

foresee.name: Foresee
foresee.description: Catches a glimpse of what is about to happen.

heal_harm.name: Heal/Harm
heal_harm.description: Restores a wounded ally or drains vitality from a target.

imbue.name: Imbue
imbue.description: Lends an ally a temporary boost to their characteristics.

influence.name: Influence
influence.description: Guides or twists what another character thinks and feels.

jerserra_s_influence.name: Jerserra's Influence
jerserra_s_influence.description: Projects a terrifying vision onto a target.

manipulate.name: Manipulate
manipulate.description: Repairs and reshapes machinery at a molecular level.

misdirect.name: Misdirect
misdirect.description: Builds illusions: hiding what is present, or showing what is not.

move.name: Move
move.description: Moves objects at a distance, from small items to considerable mass.

protect_unleash.name: Protect/Unleash
protect_unleash.description: Shields against energy or releases it as a blast.

seek.name: Seek
seek.description: Locates something lost, hidden, or deliberately concealed.

sense.name: Sense
sense.description: Detects living things nearby and reads the intent.

suppress.name: Suppress
suppress.description: Dampens Force powers used against the user and those with them.

warde_s_foresight.name: Warde's Foresight
warde_s_foresight.description: Reads one particular individual's likely actions before they take them.
